_comment: Things to do that are not media. No API, no location lookup, no business names, because anything specific would be wrong outside San Marcos and stale within a year. These are prompts, not listings. `effort` is roughly how much it costs you to start.

outing.title: Go sit near water
outing.description: The river, a lake, a fountain. Somewhere moving that you do not have to talk to.
outing.effort: Low. Shoes and a bus fare.

outing.title: See a film on your own, in the afternoon
outing.description: Nearly empty theatre, dark room, nobody looking at you, two hours accounted for.
outing.effort: Low. Cheapest ticket of the day.

outing.title: Stand in a bookshop or library for an hour
outing.description: Indoors, warm, quiet, and nobody expects you to buy anything or explain yourself.

outing.title: Walk somewhere green until you are tired
outing.description: A park, a trail, a campus loop. Being physically tired is different from being worn out.

outing.title: Go out for dessert instead of a meal
outing.description: Shorter than dinner, no menu anxiety, and easy to leave after twenty minutes.

outing.title: Wander a market with no list
outing.description: Somewhere busy enough that you disappear into it. Buy something small or nothing.

outing.title: Ask one person to come with you
outing.description: Pick any of the above and send it to one person. Doing a small thing with company counts.

hands.title: Colour something in
hands.description: Print a page or use an app. Repetitive, no decisions, and your hands stay busy.

hands.title: A game where nothing can go wrong
hands.description: Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, Unpacking. No fail state, no timer, no enemies.

hands.title: Paint along with Bob Ross
hands.description: Free on YouTube, endlessly calm, and it does not matter at all if yours looks wrong.
hands.search: Bob Ross Joy of Painting full episode

hands.title: Twenty minutes of Yoga With Adriene
hands.description: Free, gentle, no equipment, and she is explicitly kind about bad days.

hands.title: Box breathing for four minutes
hands.description: In for four, hold four, out for four, hold four. The shortest thing on this list.

hands.title: Make something that takes an hour
hands.description: Bread, soup, cookies. Following steps someone else wrote is easier than deciding.

hands.title: Reorganise one small drawer
hands.description: One drawer. Not the room. A visible finished thing in under thirty minutes.
